text: Pickup from town was on time and the driver knew exactly where to go. Directions they sent on the map were spot on, no getting lost on the mountain roads. Easy. That part was done right.
The farm was very difficult to locate without clear signage. However, the mountain views were truly magnificent.
Considering everything included, the price was very reasonable. Excellent value for money overall.
The family treated us like long lost relatives!! So warm and welcoming, we felt right at home!
The tour was fairly priced. Unfortunately, the cherry picking was rather tedious and too brief to enjoy.
guide explained super well but kinda pricey tbh
Roasting part was boring. Beans got burnt.
Roasting fail 🔥😅 but coffee yum ☕😍

I would like to commend the meal that was served during our visit. The home-cooked dishes were fresh, flavourful and clearly prepared with considerable care. The curry in particular was outstanding, and the sticky rice and vegetable sides complemented it very well. Portions were generous, and the snacks offered afterwards were equally delightful. It was one of the finest meals I have had in Thailand.
Host barely said hi and seemed annoyed we were there 😬🙃 not the warmest welcome lol
Okay I NEED a bag of these beans in my suitcase ASAP ☕️😍 Do you ship to Germany?? Asking for me, my mom, and my whole office 😂 Seriously, tell me where I can buy more!

Lunch report 🍜😄: the sticky rice and that pork dish with chili were honestly amazing, I went back for thirds 🙈 BUT the green curry was way too spicy for my weak little tongue 🔥🔥😭 and the bitter leafy soup thing... not my vibe at all. Still, the mango at the end saved the day 🥭✨ Overall 6/10 for my mouth, 10/10 for trying!

The directions provided before the visit were clear and accurate, and the pickup from town arrived precisely as arranged, which was much appreciated. Unfortunately, the meal served was disappointing. The rice was undercooked and several dishes were served cold. I would respectfully suggest preparing the food closer to serving time.

I wish to commend the remarkable natural setting. The view across the terraced hillsides toward the misty mountain ridges was truly breathtaking, particularly in the early morning light. The surrounding forest, with its birdsong and wild orchids, created an atmosphere of genuine tranquility. It is rare to encounter a landscape of such unspoiled beauty, and I shall remember it for a long time.
Food was bland and greasy.

The home-cooked lunch was excellent. Each dish was fresh, well seasoned, and thoughtfully prepared. The vegetable stir-fry and the mild curry were particular highlights. I would gladly enjoy the same meal again.
the guy explained everything super clearly, english was great, answered all my dumb questions lol
Drying and hulling part was interesting. Roasting demo was confusing, couldn't see much.
Trail itself was easy and well kept, fine. Views? Just haze and smoke. Couldn't see anything.
Mountains looked beautiful early on. Then fog rolled in and you couldn't see a thing. Lots of burnt hillsides nearby too, pretty ugly. Half great, half disappointing.
Exhausted, so keeping this short. The roasting bit was a mess, beans came out scorched and the drying racks looked neglected. That said, the price was fair, honestly cheap for what you get.

A few honest remarks. I would like to mention that the walk through the farm was rather difficult for me; the path was very steep and slippery in places, and I struggled to keep my footing. The coffee tasting, however, was lovely. The cups were smooth and fragrant, and I appreciated trying the different brews side by side.

My legs are still killing me. The trail was basically a mud slide straight up the hill, and then back down again, which was worse. Way more walking than I signed up for and half of it was slipping around in sneakers. Ok, fine, the price was honestly very reasonable, probably the cheapest tour we've done in Thailand, so I'll grudgingly say it was worth the money.
The farm walk was pleasant and easy, though the hosts seemed rather distant and unwelcoming.
Amazing value, so cheap!! The lunch was pretty bland and cold though, sadly.

ok so honestly the coffee tasting was kind of a letdown for me. like the cups were super bitter and kinda burnt tasting, and the one they said was the best just tasted sour lol. maybe it's just me but i was expecting something way smoother. had like three sips and gave up tbh. not great.

The hike nearly ended me 😅🥵 so steep and muddy, I slid down half the hill on my butt 🙈 my shoes are officially retired 👟💀 BUT the food!!! 🍜😍 the curry was incredible, the sticky rice and little fried snacks were sooo good, I went back for thirds no shame 🤤 would hike that awful hill again just for lunch lol 🍚❤️
The group was rather large, and the tour ran longer than expected.

I wish to commend the meal served during the visit; the dishes were fresh, well seasoned and clearly prepared with care. Regrettably, the coffee tasting did not meet the same standard. The samples were served lukewarm, and the flavour was flat and noticeably over-extracted. I would recommend serving the coffee freshly brewed and at the correct temperature.
The walking route was excessively steep and poorly maintained, making it unsafe in several sections.
Took us forever to find the place 😅 the map pin is way off and the last road is a mud slide 🙈 but omg the green curry and sticky rice were sooo good 😍🍛
The view was unfortunately obscured by haze; however, the roasting demonstration itself was excellent.
The tour was considerably overpriced for what was offered, in my opinion.
Regrettably, the surrounding landscape was less attractive than expected, with much of the hillside cleared.
Loved the hike through the coffee trees 🌿🥾 but kinda pricey for what it is 💸😬
Views meh. Coffee tasting excellent.
Thank you for the lunch. The rice and vegetable dishes were very nice, though some of the dishes were a little too spicy for me and the portions were rather small. Overall it was fine.
I do not wish to buy any of the beans or products, thank you.
Lovely roasting demo; won't buy beans, though.
trail was brutal lol but def buying beans
roasting part was sick, explanations confusing tho
Short tour, fine. Way overpriced though.
Picking cherries was great fun. The coffee we tasted after was weak and sour.

Picking the cherries by hand was the best part, honestly. Real work, you see how much effort goes into every bean and it was satisfying filling the basket. Getting there was a mess though. The pin on the map was wrong, no signs on the road, and our driver got lost twice. Took us almost an hour extra. Send proper directions or a pickup point before people book.
where can i buy the beans??
Ok that hill nearly killed me 😅🥵 so steep and slippery, my legs are jelly lol. BUT I'm taking 2 bags of beans home for sure ☕️🛍️ need more of this in my life!!
Good value. Won't buy the beans.
way too many people in our group, couldnt hear or see much

Thank you for showing us the processing. It was very interesting to see the washing and drying steps, and the roasting over the fire was done with obvious skill and care. I hope you will not mind me saying that the coffee itself, when we tasted it, was not quite to my liking. It seemed rather bitter and a little flat to me, though perhaps this is simply a matter of personal taste.
Omg the khao soi and sticky rice were 🔥🔥 I'd come back just to eat 😋 But the views... super hazy from the burning season, could barely see the mountains 🙈🌫️

I'm tired, cranky and my phone is at 3%, so this will be quick-ish. Not in the mood for reviews. But the lunch was genuinely the best thing I've eaten in Thailand. Green curry with veg from their garden, fresh rice, some fried banana thing at the end. Even in my state I had seconds.
Way overpriced for what you get. Not worth the money.
Too expensive. Paid triple what a similar farm charges down the road.
Roasting demo was great. Couldn't understand most of the explanations though, English very limited.
ok so the coffee tasting was honestly amazing, the second cup tasted like berries?? didn't know coffee could do that lol. but 1500 baht each felt kinda steep tbh
haha getting there was a mess, google maps sent us up some random dirt road and we had to call twice. anyway where can I order the beans online?? want a few bags for home
the pickup was like an hour late and nobody told us anything, kinda annoying. but watching them wash and dry the beans then roast them in the pan was super cool
Such great value, totally worth it!!
The cherry picking was most enjoyable.
honestly worth every baht lol, but that trail was way too muddy and steep for me

Picking cherries was boring and pointless. We spent ages hunting for a handful of ripe ones, most were still green, and my hands got scratched up by the branches. Felt like filler. That said, I want to buy beans. Do you ship to Germany or sell online? I'd order two kilos right now if I could.
Way too long. Five hours in total and we kept waiting around for a group of fifteen people to catch up. Started an hour late too. I'm exhausted.
Thank you, the directions you sent were very clear. I won't be buying any beans this time, though.
Cheap. Impossible to find the place.
Want to buy beans. Where can I order more after I get home?

The views are the only reason to come. Misty mountains, terraces, green everywhere, stunning at sunrise. The host though was cold and dismissive. Barely said hello, didn't offer us water, and seemed annoyed whenever we asked anything. Felt like we were a burden in their home. Beautiful place, unwelcoming people.
The lunch was lovely, especially the curry and sticky rice, thank you. I must admit I found the cherry picking rather tiring and not very rewarding, unfortunately.
ok the roasting part was so cool, watching the beans go from green to dark brown in the pan! picking cherries tho... kinda boring, only found a few ripe ones

Getting here was SO easy!! The pickup from our guesthouse in town was right on time, the truck ride up the mountain road felt safe, and they even sent a map pin on the messaging app beforehand just in case. Drop-off back in town was smooth too. Honestly the smoothest transport we've had in all of Thailand. Zero stress!
Thank you for having us. I did look at the bags of beans for sale at the end, but I decided not to buy any this time. They were not really what I was looking for.
I appreciated the chance to try the coffee, but I must say the cups we tasted were rather bitter and a little flat for my taste. Perhaps a lighter brew would suit more visitors.
Wow, those misty mountain views were absolutely stunning!! Best landscape of my whole trip!
Haha I was sooo curious but couldn't follow the explanations at all, the English was really hard!
Okay that hike was NO joke!! The trail up through the coffee rows was super steep and muddy, I slipped like three times and was totally out of breath. Wear proper shoes, people!
Picking the cherries was way harder than I thought 😅 my fingers got sticky, the ripe ones were hard to spot and my basket stayed sad and almost empty 🍒😂 Not my calling!
The small group size was ideal.
Tour length was fine, didn't drag. But the host barely said hello and seemed annoyed we were there.
I'm exhausted and cranky, but fine, I'll admit the price was fair for what we got.
Host family = pure sunshine ☀️🥰
Loved it! But no beans for me, thanks!
I'm beat and cranky, but fine, the home-cooked lunch was delicious.

The walk through the farm was the best part. Good trail, not too steep, and a decent distance for one morning. The host family, though, felt cold. Nobody said hello when we arrived, they barely looked up from what they were doing, and we felt like we were in the way the whole time. I don't need a big welcome, but a smile would have been nice.
Host family was not welcoming. We stood around awkwardly, nobody offered us even a glass of water, and the mother seemed annoyed we were there. Felt like an inconvenience, not a guest.

Our guide was amazing!! Explained everything so clearly in great English and answered all my silly questions. Sadly the coffee itself tasted really bitter and burnt to me, couldn't even finish my cup!
Picking the ripe coffee cherries by hand was a genuinely rewarding and memorable experience.
Tired. But the coffee was excellent.
Pickup on time, but driver got lost.
Small group was nice, fine. But I couldn't understand half of what the guide said.
Fun day, but wow, the coffee was weak!

honestly the cherry picking bit was kinda meh. most of the ripe ones were already taken so we were just hunting around the bushes for a few red ones here and there. hands got sticky and scratched too, not really my thing lol

ok so picking the cherries was honestly the best part!! loved hunting for the really red ones and filling up my little basket, felt super hands-on and kinda relaxing. the processing and roasting part tho... kinda lost me. we mostly just stood there looking at beans drying on a tarp, then the roasting was done in a pan and got a bit burnt, smoke everywhere. not much going on there tbh
Explained everything super clearly 🤓☕ but kinda pricey for what it is 💸😅

Picking was a waste of time. Bushes were half bare, we got maybe a handful of ripe cherries each and then just stood around holding empty baskets. Pointless. The food though was excellent. Proper home cooking, spicy pork curry, sticky rice, fresh greens, everything tasted great and there was plenty of it. I'd honestly come back just to eat. Lunch was the highlight, picking was the low point.
Picking fun. Lunch cold and bland. Tired.
Picking cherries was good, genuinely enjoyed that part. Not buying any beans though. The bag I looked at smelled stale and I don't need more coffee at home anyway. Picking yes, beans no.
That cup of coffee at the end?? chef's kiss 😍☕☕ smooth, fruity, zero bitterness!

Thank you for a lovely afternoon. I appreciated that the group was kept small, only five of us, which made the experience feel relaxed and personal. The pace was comfortable throughout and we never felt rushed. The tour also finished right on time, so we could keep our evening plans without any worry. The overall length felt just right, neither too short nor too long.

Getting there was a mess. The pin on the map was wrong and sent us up a dirt road to a completely different village. No signs anywhere. Phone signal died halfway so we couldn't even call. The pickup from town we were promised never showed, ended up paying a songthaew driver extra to find the place. Parking is basically a ditch by the road. Really poor.

Ugh, I'm wiped out, been up since 5 and I'm not a morning person. But credit where it's due, the timing was spot on. Started exactly when they said, no hanging around waiting for latecomers, and only six of us so it never felt like a crowd. Wrapped up in about three hours like advertised. I just wanted to get back and nap, and at least it didn't drag on.

Thank you for today. I would be interested in purchasing a few bags of your beans to bring back home, perhaps two or three if that is possible. Could you kindly let me know whether you are able to ship overseas, or if there is a shop in town where they are sold? I would also be glad to order again in the future.

Okay so honest feedback 😅 the family barely said hello when we arrived, and for most of the day it felt like we were kind of in the way 🙈 nobody really smiled or asked where we were from, and when we left the host just waved from the porch without getting up 👋😂 Felt more like visiting a grumpy uncle than a host family 😬
Couldn't follow explanations. Still want beans though.

Picking cherries was NOT my calling 😂🍒 half of mine were still green so apparently I ruined the harvest, my fingers got sticky, and the bushes kept poking me in the face 🙃 I filled maybe a quarter of my basket lol. Kinda tedious tbh and I got bored fast 😴 respect to the people who do this all day but hand picking is not for me ✋☕
Picking the cherries was quite enjoyable, though the host seemed rather uninterested in us.
Host was cold. Food was great though.
OMG the khao soi lunch was incredible, best meal of my trip!! The roasting part was a letdown though, the beans came out burnt and the drying beds were a mess. But that lunch!!!
Would like to buy beans. Snacks were bland.
Picking was fun. Coffee tasted burnt.
Way too many people in the group and it dragged on for five hours.
The directions provided in advance were clear, and the pickup from town was punctual.

Okay I NEED to take some beans home 😍☕ Already planning which suitcase pocket they'll squeeze into 🧳😂 Seriously, is there a way to order more once I'm back home? My whole office is going to want some 🙈 I'd happily grab a couple of bags of beans and maybe that jar of honey too 🍯 Please tell me you ship abroad!! 📦✈️
first cup was super smooth but the dark one was way too bitter for me tbh
Informative explanations, though sometimes hard to follow.
Couldn't understand half the explanations. Ugh.

The guide explained each step with great clarity and answered all our questions patiently. However, the roasting demonstration was disappointing; the beans were scorched and the drying area appeared poorly maintained.
Picking cherries got boring really fast.
Way too many people crammed in, and it dragged on forever. Guide explained things well though.
Nice trail. Host was cold.

Getting here was SO easy 🙌 The map pin they sent was spot on 📍 and the songthaew pickup from the town market showed up right when they said 🚐💨 Even the last bumpy bit of road had little hand-painted signs pointing the way 🪧😂 Zero stress, zero getting lost, which for me is basically a miracle 🤣 There's even a spot to park scooters 🛵✨
The home-cooked lunch was exceptionally delicious, and the curry in particular was prepared with great care.
The roasting demonstration was fascinating to watch; however, the coffee we tasted afterwards was unpleasantly bitter.
Great walk. Beans not worth buying.
Seeing the beans washed and sun-dried was interesting, although the roasting itself was rather uneven and smoky.
Skipping the beans, but wow, what fun!
Host barely said hello and seemed annoyed with us. Picking the cherries was nice though.
Picking = sticky mess 😩 lunch = heaven 😋
ok so the trail was way too steep and muddy, I nearly slid down twice lol. but honestly for what we paid it was a total bargain, can't complain about that

Haha where do I start 😅 there were like 25 of us squeezed into one tour, so half the time I couldn't see what was going on 🙈 Plus we started at 6am?!? 😴 and then everything dragged on for almost six hours. My patience was gone by noon lol. Smaller groups and a later start please 🙏

I was SO excited about the picking part and honestly it was the one thing that let me down! Most of the cherries were still green, so we spent ages hunting for a few ripe ones, and my bucket barely had a handful at the end. The branches were scratchy too and my hands got sticky. Still laughing about it, but picking was not my thing at all!
Way overpriced for what you get, honestly. Half the cost would still feel steep. The walk though was great, nice shady path, not too steep, and long enough to actually feel like a hike.
Lovely roasting demo, though somewhat pricey.

Honestly I was looking forward to the coffee most and it let me down. The cups were lukewarm by the time we got them, the first one tasted burnt and bitter, and the second was so weak it was basically brown water. I know it's a small farm but if the tasting is meant to be the highlight it should at least taste good. Not impressed, sorry.

ok so the views everyone talks about?? pretty much nothing, it was hazy and smoky the whole time and you could barely see the next hill lol. BUT the food made up for it big time. the curry was amazing, sticky rice was perfect and the little fried banana snacks omg. would come back just to eat tbh
Roasting demonstration excellent; the meal, regrettably, disappointing.

views were honestly unreal, mountains and mist everywhere, got some amazing photos. but the path down to the lower plots was a total nightmare, super steep and muddy, I slipped twice and my friend nearly rolled her ankle. maybe put in some steps or a rope there? for real
Soup amazing!! Dessert way too sweet though!
Family was SO welcoming, loved them! Couldn't follow most of the explanations though, English was tough.
Coffee was excellent, best cup I've had in Thailand, smooth and fruity. Lunch was not. Rice was cold, the stir fry was oily and bland. Skip the meal or fix it.
food was sooo good but kinda bummed, couldn't see any views with all the fog

Wow, the explanations were amazing!! Super clear English and she answered every single question we had. Honestly though, the family felt kind of cold and distant, barely said hi to us. Still, loved learning so much!
The home-cooked lunch was excellent.
Need to take a bag of these beans home!! Where can I order more online?

Picking the ripe cherries by hand was a genuinely rewarding experience, and I enjoyed carefully selecting only the red ones. Regrettably, the tasting session did not meet my expectations. The cups we were served tasted quite bitter and somewhat stale, and I found it difficult to distinguish any distinct flavours. Overall, the harvesting portion was the highlight for me.
Thank you. I must say, though, that the cost felt rather high for what was included. Perhaps it is just my own expectations, but I would not consider it good value.
The path through the plantation was well maintained and a pleasant, manageable distance.
Loved the hike!! Shame the views were hazy.

Honestly I'm wiped out and just want a shower, so this'll be brief. Not usually one for these things. But credit where it's due, the guy explaining everything was really clear, spoke decent English, and didn't ramble. Answered my dumb questions without making me feel stupid. That's more than I can say for most tours. Fine. Five stars for him, I guess.

For the modest fee charged, I believe the tour represents excellent value, and I would consider it very reasonably priced. However, the group was considerably too large, with nearly twenty participants, and the schedule ran well over the advertised time. It felt crowded throughout, and the late finish disrupted our evening plans. A smaller group and stricter timekeeping would be welcome.

OK the food 😍😍 I'm still dreaming about that green curry 🍛 and the sticky rice with mango 🥭 omg. I went back for thirds, zero shame 🙈 Grandma-level home cooking, everything fresh and so full of flavour 🌶️🌿. If I could pack the leftovers in my suitcase I absolutely would 😂 10/10 would eat again!!
Wow, that trail was brutal!! So steep and muddy, my legs are totally dead lol
Long day, I'm beat. Honestly the views were nothing special, mostly hazy and you couldn't see the mountains at all. At least the price was fair for what we got, can't complain there.
Picking the cherries myself was the best part!! Loved hunting for the ripe red ones!
ok so the views up there were unreal, misty hills everywhere, took like 200 photos. didn't buy any beans tho, the packs on the table looked kinda stale and I'm not into hauling stuff home anyway
Roasting part was good. Watching green beans turn brown in a pan, worth seeing.

Getting there was a mess. The pin on the map is wrong, our driver got lost twice, and there are zero signs on the last stretch of dirt road. Cost us an extra hour. The food made up for it though. Curry and sticky rice were excellent, best meal of my whole trip. Fix the map location and put up a sign.
Such a fun day, but I understood maybe half the explanations, the English was really hard to follow!
Picking coffee by hand was SO cool, never done anything like it, loved every minute!!

Thank you for having us. Seeing how the beans are washed, dried and hulled was very interesting to me. I must say the surroundings were less scenic than I had expected, as much of the nearby hillside has been cleared.
Pickup from our guesthouse was right on time and super easy, amazing! Only thing, the group was way too big, like 20 people, so it felt crowded and kept running late. Still loved it!

와 진짜 길이 너무 가파르고 미끄러워서 죽는 줄 알았어 ㅋㅋ 비 온 다음날이라 그런지 진흙 때문에 신발 다 버렸고 중간에 몇 번이나 넘어질 뻔했음. 체력 약한 사람은 좀 힘들 듯. 근데 숙소까지 픽업 와주신 건 완전 최고였어. 산길이 복잡해서 혼자 왔으면 절대 못 찾았을 텐데 약속한 데로 데리러 오시고 끝나고 다시 데려다주셔서 너무 편했어 ㅎㅎ 지도 핀도 미리 보내주셔서 걱정 하나도 없었음.
음식은 다소 아쉬웠으나 가격은 합리적입니다.
가격에 비해 충분히 만족스러웠습니다. 다만 설명이 영어로만 진행되어 이해하기 조금 어려웠던 점은 아쉬웠습니다.
아 진짜 너무 짧았어요!! 세 시간이 순식간에 지나가서 아쉬워 죽겠어요 ㅠㅠ 그리고 인원이 열다섯 명 넘게 한꺼번에 몰려서 정신없었어요! 다음엔 소규모로, 하루 종일 코스로 해주세요!!
찾아가는 길 완전 쉬웠어요!! 치앙마이 시내에서 출발하는 썽태우 타는 법까지 꼼꼼하게 알려주셔서 하나도 안 헤맸어요 ㅎㅎ 입구에 표지판도 크게 있고 주차 공간도 넉넉해서 렌트카로 오는 사람들도 걱정 없을 듯! 최고예요!
솔직히 경치는 기대보다 별로였어 ㅠ 사진에서 본 것처럼 산이 쫙 펼쳐질 줄 알았는데 연무가 너무 심해서 아무것도 안 보이더라. 주변도 그냥 나무만 빽빽해서 뷰 포인트라고 할 만한 데가 없었음. 근데 가격 생각하면 진짜 혜자야. 이 돈 내고 이렇게 알차게 이것저것 다 해보는 거 다른 데선 상상도 못 함. 친구들한테도 가성비 최고라고 얘기해줄 거야 ㅋㅋ

걷는 코스는 좋았음. 경사도 적당하고 길 정리가 잘 돼 있어서 운동화로도 충분했고, 한 시간 정도 걸으니 딱 기분 좋게 땀 날 정도. 문제는 설명. 뭐라고 하는지 거의 못 알아들었음. 영어도 태국어 섞여서 반은 안 들리고, 질문하면 대답이 엉뚱하게 돌아옴. 커피 품종 얘기도 대충 넘어가고. 설명을 이렇게 할 거면 차라리 안내 종이라도 한 장 주는 게 낫겠음.

농장 산책로는 매우 인상적이었습니다. 완만한 오르막과 그늘진 구간이 적절히 섞여 있어 부모님을 모시고도 무리 없이 걸을 수 있었고, 길도 잘 정비되어 있었습니다. 반면 가공 및 로스팅 과정은 다소 실망스러웠습니다. 건조장은 잠깐 지나치기만 했고, 탈곡 과정은 직접 볼 수 없었습니다. 로스팅 역시 이미 볶아 둔 원두를 보여 주는 정도에 그쳐 실제 과정을 체험하지 못한 점이 아쉬웠습니다.
커피 체리를 직접 따 보는 경험은 매우 즐거웠으나, 참가비는 다소 비싸다고 생각합니다.

价格很合理，谢谢。
现场喝的咖啡超好喝☕😋 但豆子就不买啦，真没兴趣带回去🤣
接送超准时，司机直接开到酒店门口！就是一团人太多了，挤得不行～
山间景色十分秀丽，然而前往农场的路线标识不清，较难寻找。
餐食可口，惟行程过于仓促。
直说吧，价格这块我挺纠结的。按我付的钱来算，这个价不算便宜，比城里一般的咖啡体验贵一截。但仔细想想，包含的东西其实不少，算下来也不算坑。就是收费标准应该提前写清楚，别到了现场才说有些项目要另外加钱，这点让人很不舒服。值不值看个人，我觉得一般般。
太划算了！这个价钱在别的地方根本找不到！唯一可惜的是讲解基本听不懂，英文中文都不太通，很多问题问了也没得到答案，有点遗憾～不过还是超值！

整体而言，讲解部分有待改进。向导主要使用泰语，偶尔夹杂少量英文，我们几乎无法理解其内容；提问时也常常答非所问，许多关键信息未能传达清楚。建议提供简单的中文或英文说明资料，以便游客更好地理解。
冒昧说一句，这次感觉主人家对我们不太上心，大部分时间都是我们自己待着，招待上略显怠慢，可能当天比较忙吧。不过咖啡豆本身我很喜欢，想买两包带回去送朋友，请问之后可以网购或者寄到国内吗？
烘焙环节略显一般，饭菜很好吃，谢谢。
烘豆太草率，咖啡倒是好喝。
采咖啡果的环节体验稍弱，熟果不多，大多还是青的，略感遗憾。
讲解完全听不懂！但咖啡超好喝！！
价格有点小贵啊
此次参观的农场位于群山之间，清晨云雾缭绕，远处层层叠叠的山峦十分壮观，令人印象深刻。然而，当天周边地区焚烧农田，空气中烟雾较重，远景模糊不清，原本开阔的视野大打折扣，略显遗憾。总体而言，自然风光仍有可观之处，但未能完全领略其美。
大哥讲解超用心，中文英文混着说，我们居然都听懂了哈哈。就是导航把我们带到另一条土路上，绕了快一个小时才找到入口，差点放弃回去了。
想带几包咖啡豆回去送人，有没有网店可以买啊？
山谷景色优美，梯田与远山相映成趣，令人心旷神怡。
约好的接送车迟到了快40分钟😂😂 我们在镇上路边站成了望夫石🗿 山路又窄又弯，司机还走错了一次岔口🙃 到的时候我已经晕车晕到怀疑人生🤢
小团只有我们一家，超自在！就是上坡路太陡了，腿都软了哈哈！
整个行程安排得刚刚好，早上九点出发，中午前就结束了，不赶也不拖。而且就我们四个人，想问什么随时问，很舒服。不过午饭真的一般般，菜偏咸又有点凉了，糯米饭也硬硬的，可能不太合我们口味吧，吃了几口就没怎么动了。
累死了。从清迈开过来路况差得要命，最后一段全是泥坑，车差点陷进去，导航还一直让我们掉头。到了也没地方停车，只能停在路边斜坡上，提心吊胆的。唉，算了，咖啡豆还是想买两袋带回去，能不能寄到马来西亚啊？
整体时间稍长了一些，团里人也略多，部分时候有些拥挤。
说实话，这次一个团塞了二十多个人，太多了，每到一个点都要等半天，节奏拖得特别慢。原本说三个小时，结果搞了快五个小时，下午的安排全泡汤了。早上七点半就集合也太早了点。不过山上的风景是真的没话说，云海、梯田、远处的山一层一层的，随手一拍都是大片。
豆子想打包带走😍 山路陡到腿软😵
价格很实惠，只是地方不太好找。
烘豆居然烤糊了哈哈！好可惜啊！！
接送超级准时！司机直接到酒店门口接我们，一路顺顺利利，完全不用操心！可惜处理豆子那部分有点敷衍，晒豆、脱壳都只是看一眼就过去了，烘焙也很草率，有点失望～
摘咖啡果摘得手都酸了，又累又无聊。还好最后那杯咖啡挺好喝的。
累死了，困得不行……不过摘咖啡果那段确实挺好玩的。
直说吧，采摘环节挺让人失望的。说是亲手摘咖啡果，结果树上没剩几颗熟的，大部分都是青的，摘了十分钟就没得摘了，桶底都没铺满，完全没体验感。倒是午饭很惊喜，家常的泰北菜，咖喱面和炒青菜都很香，糯米饭配辣酱我吃了两碗，比城里很多餐厅都好吃。
导航一搜就到了👍 路口还有小木牌指路，停车位也很宽敞，完全没迷路，给个大大的赞🚗✨ 但是！说好的云海呢？☁️❌ 那天雾蒙蒙的啥也看不见，远处的山全是灰的，拍出来跟没拍一样😂 旁边还有一片山被烧过，光秃秃的有点煞风景🙈 景色这块真的小失望啦～
